title: ZoneLock: dedicated-node proof collector and certification reporting
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Build a lightweight, auditable service (ZoneLock) that continuously collects cryptographic locality proofs and runtime metadata from dedicated capacity nodes and packages them into tamper-evident certification bundles for customer-facing residency reports. These bundles are intended for customer audits and regulator requests and must be machine-verifiable and human-readable.

Scope:
- Collect: periodic node heartbeat, geo-ip, cloud-region metadata, instance certificate thumbprints, kube/node tags, kernel timestamp, and measured network egress paths.
- Normalize: canonicalize metadata into a compact schema suitable for signing and long-term retention.
- Sign: attach a short-lived signature from a rotation-friendly signing key and include key-wrapping metadata for KMS-based verification.
- Bundle & Publish: produce a per-tenant, per-day bundle with index and manifest pushed to the customer audit store and recorded to an append-only evidence index.
- Reporting UI hooks: expose metadata for the Console report that allows customers to download bundles and verify signatures.

Out of scope for this ticket: long-term legal certification, third-party notarization, and certified hardware attestation (future follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: ZoneLock service runs in staging and can collect heartbeat + region metadata from a subset of dedicated nodes
Generated bundles are JSON-LD formatted, signed with KMS-backed keys, and include a manifest and checksum
Bundles are published to the per-tenant audit S3 bucket with a consistent path pattern and lifecycle tags
Console can surface a sample bundle link for a tenant and verify signature via public key endpoint
Automated integration test validates end-to-end collection -> sign -> publish flow and a synthetic verification job runs nightly
implementation_steps: Design a minimal canonical schema for residency proofs (schema doc in Confluence)
Implement collector agent as a lightweight sidecar on dedicated nodes that emits signed heartbeats to ZoneLock ingestion API
Build ZoneLock ingestion service with batching, deduplication, and normalization pipeline
Integrate with KMS for ephemeral signing keys and publish verification key endpoint
Persist bundles to tenant audit buckets and append index entries to the evidence index (append-only S3 prefix + DynamoDB index)
Add Console API to list bundles and perform signature verification using cached public keys
Create automated tests and a canary rollout to 5% of dedicated tenants in staging
testing_plan: Unit tests for schema normalizer and signature verification
Integration test using a fake dedicated-node sidecar in CI that goes through end-to-end flow
Chaos test: simulate clock skew and transient network partition to ensure pipeline retries and idempotency
Security test: verify KMS key rotation behavior does not break verification of previously published bundles
Manual QA: Console download + verification flow with Security and PM sign-off
rollout_plan: Deploy ZoneLock ingestion and Console features to staging, run them for 48h against canary nodes
Run nightly synthetic verification for 7 days, ensure <1% verification failures
Gradual rollout: enable for 10% of dedicated tenants in staging, then 25% in prod, monitoring telemetry
Full rollout to all dedicated nodes after one-week burn and security review completion

2026-03-10 - PM Review (Maya Singh): Approved scope, asked to include Console UX for download + verification badge. PM requested a short sample bundle for legal review.
